Reason for Mistake: The user made an initial factual error in the first step by incorrectly identifying Catherine de Braganza as Marie Zéphyrine of France's paternal grandmother. Marie Zéphyrine was the daughter of Louis, Dauphin of France, and Maria Josepha of Saxony; therefore, her paternal grandmother was Maria Josepha's mother, Archduchess Maria Amalia of Austria. Catherine de Braganza was the wife of Charles II of England and had no relation to the French royal line of Marie Zéphyrine. This error propagated until the WebSurfer corrected it based on search results.
